newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian surf pro saved by lifeguards.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian surf pro saved by lifeguards.

text.p: A professional Australian surfer had to be rescued by lifeguards on Tuesday after suffering a panic attack in giant waves off the Victoria coast.
Christopher Davidson, 20, was pulled from the ocean after winning the second round of the Bell's Beach surfing contest in waves three to four metres high.

"I was trying to breathe deep but I was starting to panic because I needed to dive deep and I looked around and saw I was right in front of the rocks," Davidson said. His opponent lost after a wave broke his surfboard in half.
